overviews.title: MBA in Data Science: Course Fees, Eligibility, Admission, Syllabus, Top Colleges, Salary & Scope

blocks.value: The MBA in data science course is rapidly becoming a highly coveted specialization in management to leverage data effectively in a business context . As industries increasingly adopt technology and scientific methods for their operations, the ability to assess and manage data has become crucial. This professional program will help you develop skills to drive business innovations through data.

Data science transforms vast amounts of data into actionable insights and informed predictions. It's the art of deciphering complex data sets to guide decision-making and forecast future trends. Imagine data science as a form of investigative work. Data scientists gather, scrutinize, and interpret data to uncover answers to critical questions. Their analyses range from identifying consumer purchasing trends to detecting health-related patterns that could aid in disease prevention.

blocks.value: MBA in Data Science Eligibility Criteria

value: The eligibility criteria to pursue an MBA in Data Science is graduation. However, since Data Science is all about data crunching, having an academic background in Mathematics, Statistics, Information Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning will be valuable.
Some of the MBA programs in data science colleges have minimum score criteria of 50 percent aggregate in graduation.

questions.question_text: Is Macquarie University good for Masters in Data Science course?

answers.answer_text: MQ University Masters in Data Science course is 1-2 year long course. The tuition fees for international students at this university is AUD 46,300 . In the QS subject rankings for 2025 for Data Science & AI, MQ Uni ranks among the Top 100 in the world.

questions.question_text: Is the Lehigh University Pennsylvania good for Data Science?

answers.answer_text: Lehigh is a strong choice for a Data Science program. It is a top-tier R1 university that gives emphasis on practical learning. The MS in Data Science is a 11-month programme delivered by the PC Rossin College of Engineering and Applied Science . The programme helps build a strong base in data analysis and opens careers in fields like Finance, Risk Management, and Marketing Analytics . Students can apply for a OPT extension after completing the programme and work for top US based companies.

questions.question_text: What are the career opportunities after completing the B Tech AI and Data Science programme at Terna College of Engineering?

answers.answer_text: The students who graduate from the BTech Artificial Intelligence and Data Science programme can get into the data Science field. There are a lot of career options one can get into. Some of them are AI researchers , Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers. The programme prepares the candidates on the latest skillset, which helps them stay updates to the job market. The candidates who choose this specialisation have better job opportunities.

questions.question_text: What is the duration of Birkbeck University of London MSc in Data Science?

answers.answer_text: Birkbeck University of London MSc in Data Science is 1 year long. This course offers students hands-on experience with programming languages. The teaching is combined with rigorous academic training with practical application. The tuition fees for this course is GBP 22,980 per year (Around INR 29 lakh).

questions.question_text: What is the duration and seat intake for the B Tech Artificial Intelligence and Data Science programme at Terna College of Engineering?

answers.answer_text: The BTech AI and DS programme at Terna College of Engineering is of 4 years. The total intake for the programme is 60 seats. This programme gives students the opportunity to gain skills in the latest tech and machine learning. These skills provide the students with the latest skills in the AI and data science.

questions.question_text: How long is the MSc in Interdisciplinary Data Science and AI course of New York University-Abu Dhabi?

answers.answer_text: NYU Abu Dhabi MSc in Interdisciplinary Data Science and AI course is a two-year long course . While studying this course, students are going to gain exclusive partnerships with govt. and industry leaders in the Gulf region and Abu Dhabi. Also, NYUAD scholarships are available for students enrolled in this course.

questions.question_text: What is the median package of BE/BTech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science course offered at SDM- Institute of Technology?

answers.answer_text: The Artificial Intelligence and Data Science specialisation of BE/BTech course offered at SDM- Institute of Technology is INR 4 lakh. However, the given median salary number is taken from the official website of the college. It is still subject to change and hence, is indicative.

questions.question_text: What is the duration of MSc Data Science and Business Analytics course of Amsterdam University?

answers.answer_text: Amsterdam Uni MSc Data Science and Business Analytics course duration is 12 months. This course is taught in English. Students must have a Bachelor's degree for admission to this course in Business Analytics, Econometrics or any other closely related area.

questions.question_text: Should I choose Intellipaat or Simplilearn for Data Science / DevOps / Cloud certification?
How is Masters in Data Science programme at Brown University?

answers.answer_text: Brown University provide 1-2 year Masters in Data Science programme to international students. The programme is good blend of innovation and impact on data driven world. The programme help students with the basics of Computer Science, Mathematics, and Statistics. Students can expect to learn machine learning, data mining, visualization, and data management.
